<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Okay, Brad's response indicates that my previous approach of sending a pre-filtered list was too restrictive. He needs all the mutual availability for Priya and Marcus, not just the slots I picked out. I already did the analysis in my head in the last step, so I just need to format it clearly for him.

Let me re-list the common free slots I found earlier.

*   **Monday, Nov 16:** 09:00-10:00 (two 30-min slots: 09:00, 09:30)
*   **Tuesday, Nov 17:** 13:00-14:00 (two 30-min slots: 13:00, 13:30)
*   **Wednesday, Nov 18:** 15:00-16:00 (two 30-min slots: 15:00, 15:30)
*   **Thursday, Nov 19:** 10:00-10:30 (one 30-min slot: 10:00)
*   **Friday, Nov 20:** 11:00-12:00 (two 30-min slots: 11:00, 11:30)

I will send this complete list to Brad. This should give him enough information to find a suitable time.Hi Brad. No problem. Here is the complete list of all 30-minute slots where both Priya and Marcus are available next week.

*   Monday, Nov 16: 09:00, 09:30
*   Tuesday, Nov 17: 13:00, 13:30
*   Wednesday, Nov 18: 15:00, 15:30
*   Thursday, Nov 19: 10:00
*   Friday, Nov 20: 11:00, 11:30

Let me know which of these works for Elena and David.
